command_argv:
set -e; git -c core.quotePath=false status --short --branch; sha256sum src/agentic_payment_experiment/trusted_execution/known_payment_attempt.py tests/trusted_execution/test_known_payment_attempt.py tests/test_webshop_runtime_gate.py samples/evaluation/project_impact_t10_preflight_target_v1.json scripts/validation/run_project_impact_baseline.py; PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 - <<'PY'
from dataclasses import replace
from tests.trusted_execution.test_known_payment_attempt import KnownPaymentAttemptPreflightTests
from tests.test_webshop_runtime_gate import WebShopRuntimeGateTest
from agentic_payment_experiment import PaymentStatus

fact_case = KnownPaymentAttemptPreflightTests(methodName="test_unrelated_succeeded_attempt_does_not_block_or_call_binding")
fact_case.setUp()
unrelated = replace(fact_case.succeeded, payment_id="", request_id="request-other", transaction_object_ref="request-other", status=PaymentStatus.SUCCEEDED)
fact = fact_case.derive((unrelated,))
print("FACT_STATUS=" + fact.status.value)
print("FACT_REASONS=" + repr(fact.reason_codes))

gate_case = WebShopRuntimeGateTest(methodName="test_unrelated_succeeded_attempt_is_clear_and_checkout_still_runs")
gate_case.setUp()
unrelated_gate = replace(gate_case.execution, payment_id="", request_id="request-unrelated", transaction_object_ref="request-unrelated", status=PaymentStatus.SUCCEEDED)
outcome, calls = gate_case.invoke(governed_action=gate_case.governed_action, known_payment_attempts=(unrelated_gate,))
print("GATE_DECISION=" + outcome.decision.value)
print("GATE_CALLBACK_COUNT=" + str(outcome.callback_count))
print("GATE_CALLS=" + repr(calls))
print("GATE_PREFLIGHT=" + outcome.known_payment_attempt_preflight_fact.status.value)
assert fact.status.value == "INDETERMINATE"
assert outcome.decision.value == "INDETERMINATE"
assert outcome.callback_count == 0
PY
